name: core-runtime-search-suggest-deterministic-mock
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves deterministic local Search.suggest overload behavior only; it makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.

source.content: @IsTest private class SearchSuggestMockTest { @IsTest static void suggestOverloads() { System.assertNotEquals(null, Search.suggest('Acme', 'Account', (Object)new Search.SuggestionOption())); System.assertNotEquals(null, Search.suggest('Acme', 'Account', (Object)new Search.SuggestionOption(), (Object)System.AccessLevel.USER_MODE)); } }
